verdict.rationale: Token2's FIDO2 demo tool can look up any certified authenticator by name or AAGUID, and it can run browser WebAuthn registrations. That gives a glancing aid for identifying key models, but nothing in the evidence shows attestation statement verification or enforcement of an approved-model allowlist at registration. The Entra ID bulk-enrollment tool registers keys but is not described as filtering by attestation. Missing for 10: attestation certificate/statement verification, AAGUID allowlist enforcement at enrollment, documentation of relying-party-side attestation policy, independent corroboration.
